name: ODFW Oregon Conservation and Recreation Fund

funder.name: Oregon Department of Fish and Wildlife

administered_by.name: Oregon Department of Fish and Wildlife

summary: Oregon grants of up to $25,000 for conservation and outdoor recreation projects, including restoration, monitoring and community engagement, with a stated aim of supporting smaller and newer organisations.

opens.quote: The application period opens on December 15, 2026 and closes on February 9, 2027.

deadline.quote: Please make sure you complete the funding application before 11:59pm on February 9, 2027.

administered_by.quote: Oregon Department of Fish and Wildlife ODFW

applicant_types.quote: Eligible entities include any tribe, watershed council, soil and water conservation district, not-for-profit corporation, school, institution of higher education, state agency, federal agency, local government

geography.quote: The OCRF will prioritize projects that implement the State Wildlife Action Plan (formerly known as the Oregon Conservation Strategy), a blueprint for conserving Oregon's fish and wildlife and their habitats

access.quote: Accepting applications through the ODFW online grant portal.

window.quote: The application period opens on December 15, 2026 and closes on February 9, 2027.

amount.quote: The maximum allowable grant request for projects will be $50,000.

co_finance_required.quote: NO - The OCRF has no minimum match requirements or any match requirements.
